product.name: Maestro Property Management System (PMS)
product.description: An all-in-one hotel and resort property management system available on web browser and Windows platforms, deployable on-premises or cloud.

product.name: Front Office & CRM Module
product.description: Software module for managing front desk operations and customer relationship management in hospitality properties.

product.name: Sales & Catering Module
product.description: A module to manage sales activities and catering services within hospitality properties.

product.name: Spa & Activities Module
product.description: Software module for managing spa services and guest activities in hospitality properties.

product.name: Online Booking Engine
product.description: A web-based system for managing online reservations and bookings for hospitality properties.

product.name: Condo Owner & Online Portal
product.description: A portal for condominium owners and guests to access property-related information and services online.
